description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerOptions class which encapsulates configuration settings for stateless worker grains in Orleans. It includes properties to control behavior such as idle worker removal and inspection periods.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerOptions
classes.description: A configuration class for managing options related to stateless worker grains, including idle worker removal and inspection timings.

methods.name: RemoveIdleWorkers
methods.description: A boolean property that, when true, enables proactive deactivation of idle workers by the runtime.

methods.name: DEFAULT_REMOVE_IDLE_WORKERS
methods.description: A constant boolean default indicating whether idle workers should be removed by default (true).

methods.name: IdleWorkersInspectionPeriod
methods.description: A TimeSpan property defining how often the system inspects for idle workers.

methods.name: DEFAULT_IDLE_WORKERS_INSPECTION_PERIOD
methods.description: A static readonly TimeSpan defaulting to 500 milliseconds for the inspection period.

methods.name: MinIdleCyclesBeforeRemoval
methods.description: An integer property specifying the number of consecutive idle cycles needed before removing a worker.

methods.name: DEFAULT_MIN_IDLE_CYCLES_BEFORE_REMOVAL
methods.description: A constant integer default set to 3 for the minimum idle cycles before removal.
